source: Manual summary of the current website structure as it exists in the primary repo. This file is a reference data layer only; the live website does NOT consume it.

site.name: Erin Wong Portfolio
site.description: Single-page-plus-detail-pages static portfolio website for Erin Wong (architectural designer). Doubles as an online CV.

deployment.live_repo: E:\my-portfolio-website\eerrrrr.github.io (backup mirror — GitHub Pages user-pages repo)
deployment.deployment_model: Pushes to backup repo main branch publish via GitHub Pages within ~30s. Pushes to primary repo do NOT publish.

main_pages.purpose: Homepage. Hero (mp4 video), about block, masonry project grid, sticky CV sidebar.

css.purpose: All site-wide styling. CSS variables defined in :root at the top of the file. RWD breakpoints at 1400px and 768px.

js.purpose: Masonry init, filterByType / filterProjects / filterByTag, sticky-nav scroll behaviour, dead WebGL hero (initLiquidChrome — currently inactive).

i18n.purpose: 5-language dictionary (en, zh, fi, de, ja) and runtime translation engine. Resolves [data-i18n] elements. Sets document.documentElement.lang on language switch.
i18n.fallback_chain: I18N[currentLang][key] → I18N.en[key] → null (element keeps its existing HTML content)

main page.rename_safety: DO NOT rename — referenced by relative URL in index.html

routing.type: static file routing via GitHub Pages

url_rewrites.behaviour: After applying a type filter on the homepage, the URL is rewritten via history.replaceState to /<short-code> (e.g. /arch, /furn, /3d, /vr, /aigc). On page load, the URL path is read back and the filter is re-applied. Fallback: ?f=<short-code> query parameter is also supported.

routing.404_handling: 404.html serves as the GitHub Pages 404 page.

filename_risks.details: GitHub Pages is case-sensitive (Linux backend). The repo contains mixed-case filenames: 'Single-family-home.html', 'Study-group-Works.html', 'Studio-Renovation_icon.png', etc. Any href, src, or fetch must match the case of the actual file exactly.

Several pages use an i18n prefix that doesn't match the filename. Per PORTFOLIO_I18N_SYSTEM.md: Single-family-home.html → 'sfh', tri-stool.html → 'ruach', Study-group-Works.html → 'study', cultural-center.html → 'cultural', furniture-park.html → 'park', studio-renovation.html → 'studio', vault-house.html → 'vault'. Future code that maps page → i18n keys must use this mapping, not derive it from the filename.
tri-stool.html uses assets from ruach/ folder, not tri-stool/ (which is empty). Study-group-Works.html uses study-group/ folder.
'main page/' contains a space. References in HTML use 'main%20page/'. Common source of broken URLs if the folder is renamed.

Inconsistent image naming inside project folders: spaces, semicolons, mixed case, dates, auto-generated names. Examples: 'Canvas at 14;45;40 1.png' (bamboo/), 'Generated Image December 26, 2025 - 10_28PM.png' (bamboo/), 'stool-main 拷貝2.jpg' (stool/), '1241.003 Eave detail 0003.jpg' (Single-family-home/). Each must be URL-encoded if referenced from HTML.

fragile_runtime_behaviour.details: When the 'architecture' type filter is active, script.js moves the Single-family-home card before the tearoom card in the DOM, then restores the original order for other filters. Any code that re-orders the cards must respect this swap.

After Masonry layout settles, AOS attributes are stripped from all project cards so subsequent filter actions don't re-trigger fly-in animations. Adding new project cards that should animate-on-first-view requires data-aos attributes to be present BEFORE Masonry init.
Every HTML file includes <script src="i18n.js?v=4">. If i18n.js changes, ALL HTML files must have their ?v= value incremented in lockstep. There is no automated bumping.
fragile_runtime_behaviour.note: STATE.md is out of date for the cache version. Reconcile in a future docs pass.

fragile_runtime_behaviour.details: Looks for <canvas id="hero-canvas">. The current index.html has no such canvas — it uses <video id="hero-video"> instead. The function returns early. Not user-visible. Documented in CLAUDE.md as intentional dead code pending a possible WebGL hero revival.

external_dependencies_cdn.name: imagesloaded
external_dependencies_cdn.purpose: wait for images before Masonry layout

contents: PORTFOLIO_I18N_SYSTEM.md (i18n key naming rules, translation policy)
NEW_PROJECT_CHECKLIST.md (step-by-step for adding a new project)
verify_i18n.py (validator script that checks key parity across 5 languages)
external_doc_references.authority: For i18n key naming, translation policy, and cache-version procedure, the support documents folder is authoritative over the per-repo CLAUDE.md.
